backend/main.mo: Actor that includes blob-storage mixin for storage functionality.

frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style list summarizing major frontend components, their purpose, and recent updates.

frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Overview of deployment options including IC canister and GoDaddy static hosting.
frontend/disclaimer.html: Static HTML entry point for the Disclaimer page with loading fallback and script mount.
frontend/FTP_UPLOAD_TO_GODADDY.md: Step-by-step instructions for uploading the static site to GoDaddy via FTP.
frontend/gdpr.html: HTML entry page for the GDPR section with loading fallback, noscript message, and script loading gdpr.tsx.
frontend/GO_DADDY_EXPORT.md: Instructions for generating a static HTML/CSS/JS export package for GoDaddy hosting.
frontend/index.html: Main site entry HTML with loading fallback, noscript message, and script loading index.tsx.
frontend/product-offerings.html: HTML entry for product offerings page with loading fallback and script loading product-offerings.tsx.
frontend/ROLLBACK_NOTES.md: History and verification details for rollbacks, including the full restore to version 88.

frontend/scripts/export-godaddy-zip.sh: Bash script that builds the site, runs a smoke check, and creates a ZIP file for GoDaddy deployment.
frontend/scripts/smoke-check-static-buil: Shell script that validates the static build by checking for required files, assets, and content structure.
frontend/src/.well-known/ic-domains: Lists allowed domains for deployment verification.

frontend/src/components/CountryPopup.tsx: File is empty or contains no implemented content.

frontend/src/components/DisclaimerSectio: Shows multiple disclaimer blocks outlining limits of liability, accuracy, and legal responsibility.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with company info, navigation links, and social media icons.

frontend/src/components/GlobeSection.tsx: Empty file placeholder for a future globe-related UI component.

frontend/src/components/InteractiveGlobe: Empty file placeholder for an interactive globe component.

Provides tabbed product offering sections with student, professional, investor, and ancillary services. Supports URL hash deep linking and renders detailed accordion content.
frontend/src/components/WhyChooseUs.tsx: Displays reasons to choose the consultancy along with USP cards and ancillary services list. Includes descriptive content emphasizing expertise, security, and support.
frontend/src/entries/about.tsx: Entry point that mounts the About page with React Query, theming, and the static site layout.
frontend/src/entries/contact.tsx: Entry point that mounts the Contact page using React Query, theming, and the static site layout.
frontend/src/entries/disclaimer.tsx: Bootstraps the Disclaimer page using React Query, theming, and StaticSiteLayout with safeMount.
frontend/src/entries/gdpr.tsx: Bootstraps the GDPR page with React Query, theming, and StaticSiteLayout via safeMount.
frontend/src/entries/index.tsx: Bootstraps the Home page using React Query, theming, and StaticSiteLayout with safeMount.
frontend/src/entries/product-offerings.t: Bootstraps the Product Offerings page with React Query, theming, and StaticSiteLayout via safeMount.
frontend/src/entries/why-choose-us.tsx: Bootstraps the Why Choose Us page using React Query, theming, and StaticSiteLayout with safeMount.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on change.

frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder hook returning no backend queries since the site is static.

frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom light/dark theme variables for the site.
frontend/src/layouts/StaticSiteLayout.ts: Layout component that wraps pages with a header, footer, main container, and toast system.

frontend/src/main.tsx: Main entry point rendering App within React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Composes the home layout with Hero, Map, CountrySlideshow, and CategorySection.
frontend/src/routeTree.tsx: Defines the site’s route tree with a root layout and page routes using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/utils/safeMount.ts: Safely mounts React apps and installs global error handlers with a fallback error UI.
frontend/src/utils/staticSiteLinks.ts: Provides helpers to build relative links to static HTML pages and navigate to them, plus a map of main page links.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Offers utilities to read URL or hash parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and manage stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Sets up Vite with React, path aliases, and multiple HTML entry points for building a multi-page site.
frontend/why-choose-us.html: HTML entry page for the Why Choose Us section, showing a loading fallback and loading a React entry script.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing rollback plans, known issues, features, and pending rebuild request state.
